description: Turn two still frames into scroll animation code for a website, in plain words, with any AI agent. Your AI agent drafts the workflow, you make the frames in Whisk, generate an 8 second video in Flow, extract the frames with EZGIF, then the agent drafts the prompt that turns the frames into interactive scroll animation code.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
